entry.vector: From rest on a cut. The 1.16→1.00 scale settle and the 5px→0px blur clear are withdrawn; the scene opens with content arriving instead — the title 'הכאב' whips up at 0.08s and the first ledger chip starts its depth-scatter assembly at 0.28s.

exit.vector: Outward, in-plane, still moving. The counter recedes into the opened space through the final frame: opacity 1→0.42 and figstack scale 1→0.86 both run 14.05–16.00s on power2.in, and the two halves of the broken ₪0 keep parting (±24px over 14.35–16.00s on power1.in, ≈29 px/s each at the last frame — an accelerating ease that is at maximum velocity exactly when the cut lands). The teal bloom holds the opened centre. No camera moves; only elements travel.

first_second: 0.00–1.00s — a plain cut in, at rest on frame 0. The title 'הכאב' whips up at 0.08s, its accent underline sweeps at 0.24s, body line 1 at 0.42s, and the first ledger chip begins its depth-scatter assembly at 0.28s. The world is never scaled or blurred.
last_second: 15.00–16.00s — no reveals, no exits, no camera. The chips and pills have settled at their outward positions, but the counter is still receding (opacity and figstack scale both land exactly on 16.00s) and the two broken counter halves are still separating on an accelerating power1.in. The teal bloom holds the opened centre. Frame 03 (transition_in: cut) lands the phone into exactly that hole.
retime_note: RETIMED 19/08 — 20s → 16s (−20%) for the tightened cut. Positions and durations were scaled ×0.8 and then hand-tuned. The cut was taken from HOLD, not from the climax: the stillness before the break drops 1.80s → 1.19s (10.91–12.10s), while the break itself keeps 3.90s of its original 4.60s — ratio 0.85, deliberately over proportional, because the ₪0 splitting is the scene's whole argument. The frozen-counter count-up also held over (2.40s → 2.10s, not 1.92s) so 142 עסקאות / ₪5,630 stay legible as they resolve. Chip and pill scatter/expansion travel distances are unchanged; only their arrival cadence tightened.
seam_note: REVISED 18/08 — every camera tween in this scene is deleted: the entry settle and the post-break forward creep. The overwhelm-surround contract is unchanged and is now literal — the crowd closes on the subject and the lens never moves at all. The counter breaks at 12.10s. Because 01-open no longer exits on a push, the storyboard's `transition_in` should be stamped as a cut.
data_note: The six brand chips in the crowd are now real clubs read from the `clubs` collection — Isracard TopCash, PaisPlus, HOT Israel, Behatsdaa, Swish (נפשונית), Mastercard Israel — replacing the invented Visa / Mastercard / retail-chain placeholders. The Swish chip carries dir="ltr" so the Latin/Hebrew mix cannot be reordered by the bidi algorithm. The generic clutter chips (קופון · קבלה · הטבה · ×3 נקודות) are unchanged.
